meta_description: AbbeyCliffe Plumbing in Rotherham provides emergency plumbing repairs, installations, and maintenance. Same-day service available. Call 07761 705832 now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Rotherham? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle every plumbing problem in your home or business.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking taps, and blocked drains fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to complete most jobs in a single visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing
services.desc: Gas Safe registered installation and annual servicing. We fit Worcester and Vaillant boilers with 10-year guarantees and help you find the right system for your home.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: New heating systems, radiator upgrades, and power flushing to improve efficiency. Reduce your heating bills and stay warm all winter.

services.title: Bathroom Fitting
services.desc: Complete bathroom transformations including suites, tiling, and plumbing. We manage every detail so you enjoy a beautiful, functional space.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Find hidden leaks in pipes and water mains before they cause damage. Our diagnostic approach saves you money on unnecessary excavation.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Clear blocked toilets, sinks, and sewers using modern jetting equipment. We get your drains flowing freely without mess or hassle.

about_pullquote: I started AbbeyCliffe because I hated seeing Rotherham families charged over the odds for honest work.
about_para_1: AbbeyCliffe Plumbing has served Rotherham and South Yorkshire for 18 years. We're a Gas Safe registered, family-run business built on fair pricing and reliable work. Whether it's a burst pipe at midnight or a new boiler system, we turn up on time, finish the job properly, and charge you only what we quote.
about_para_2: Our customers keep coming back because we answer our phones, explain what's wrong without the jargon, and stand behind every job with a written guarantee. We're locals who understand Rotherham's homes — old Victorian terraces, new builds, and everything in between. You'll get the same tradesman for follow-up work, not a stranger.
reviews_heading: What Rotherham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe in the kitchen on a Sunday morning. Called AbbeyCliffe and they were here within 50 minutes. Fixed it properly, cleaned up after themselves, and the quote was spot on. Top lads.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted last month. The lads were professional, polite, and left the place spotless. They explained everything clearly and we're saving a fortune on our heating bills. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called for a leaking radiator in the middle of the night. Expected to pay a fortune but they charged a fair rate and got it sorted within an hour. Rare to find honest tradesmen these days. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Simon P.
